aboutMeDescription: I'm a computer science student and software developer with a knack for building efficient and scalable applications. My expertise spans backend development with Go, Node.js; frontend frameworks like React and Angular, and optimizing performance in complex systems. I enjoy tackling challenges like crafting robust APIs, implementing microservices, and delivering seamless user experiences.

name: Carlos David Sandoval Vargas
title: CS student at Tecnológico de Monterrey

experience.description: Interned at Irvine Systems in Tokyo, Japan, designing and implementing various systems for clients. I was involved in full-cycle development including documentation, architecture design, and implementation of both backend and frontend. I worked on developing a system utilizing an AI model with a custom RAG system for chatting capabilities.

Interned at Wizeline's Academy team, contributing to their own version of the Odoo e-learning module by implementing new views and backend models for a lecturer's feature, managing data retrieval, and overseeing code reviews and merges from development to staging.

projects.name: Online Flip Flop
projects.subtitle: Real-time Multiplayer Strategy Game
projects.description: An online multiplayer implementation of FlipFlop, the abstract strategy board game by Masahiro Nakajima. Features multiplayer gameplay, spectator mode, and an in-game chat.

projects.name: My Movie List
projects.subtitle: Interactive Movie App
projects.description: An Interactive Movie app that allows you to create lists and keep track of the movies and TV shows you are watching or plan to watch.

projects.name: Avenue Multi Agent System Simulation
projects.subtitle: Simulation
projects.description: A multi-agent system project to visualize the behavior of vehicles on an avenue.

projects.name: LOGO
projects.subtitle: Implementation of a LOGO interpreter
projects.description: This is a collaborative project to develop a LOGO programming language designed to help students learn the basic concepts of programming logic. A set of commands can be entered to move a robot across the screen and create drawings.

projects.name: Go-TCP-Chat
projects.subtitle: Terminal Chat Application
projects.description: Go-TCP-Chat is a TCP-based chat application implemented in Golang. It supports multiple clients, chat rooms, and various commands for an interactive chatting experience.

projects.name: GopherStore
projects.subtitle: Lightweight Redis Clone
projects.description: A lightweight Redis clone written in Go, with support for strings and lists. Implements the RESP protocol with key expiration, concurrent access, and a web interface for testing commands.

projects.name: DamiPic
projects.subtitle: Generate placeholder images
projects.description: Interactive website that allows users to generate placeholder images. Users can select the size, color, image format, and add text to display on the image.

projects.name: New Year Countdown
projects.subtitle: Page that counts down to the new year with fireworks
projects.description: Counts down to the new year in the user's timezone. Allows users to shoot firesworks that other users can see as well.

projects.name: Dead Links Checker
projects.subtitle: Web Scraper to check for dead links
projects.description: A web scraper that checks for dead links in a website and returns a list of broken links.

projects.name: Bad Apple in ASCII
projects.subtitle: ASCII Video Player
projects.description: An app that displays the Bad Apple video in the terminal using ASCII characters.

projects.name: Snake in Python
projects.subtitle: Snake in python but with a train instead
projects.description: A Snake game implemented in Python with pygame, where you control a train and pick up passengers. You can go through walls that teleport you to the opposite side of the map but if you collide with yourself you lose. The game also saves the highest score achieved. You can download the game using the link below.

projects.name: DB Compare
projects.subtitle: Command line tool to compare databases
projects.description: A command line tool that compares two databases and returns the differences in different formats.
